### SouthState Bank Corporation to Announce Quarterly Earnings Results on Wednesday, October 21, 2026


October 2, 2026


WINTER HAVEN, Fla.


, Oct. 2, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- SouthState Bank Corporation (NYSE: SSB) ("SouthState" or the "Company") announced today that it will release third quarter 2026 earnings results on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, after the market closes. Upon release, investors may access a copy of SouthState's earnings results at the Company's website at[www.SouthStateBank.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787722-1&h=1034033618&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southstatebank.com%2F&a=www.SouthStateBank.com) under Investor Relations, News, News & Market Data section.


SouthState will host a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. (ET) to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. Investors may call in (toll free) by dialing (833) 461-5787 within the US (host: Will Matthews, CFO). The conference ID number is 728284222. The numbers for international participants are listed at[https://help.events.q4inc.com/eahc/international-dial-in-numbers](https://help.events.q4inc.com/eahc/international-dial-in-numbers) . Participants may also pre-register for the conference by navigating to[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/728284222](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787722-1&h=4016482199&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F728284222&a=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F728284222) . Access detail will be provided via email upon completion of registration.


Alternatively, individuals may listen to the live webcast of the presentation by visiting the link at SouthState's website at[www.SouthStateBank.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787722-1&h=1034033618&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southstatebank.com%2F&a=www.SouthStateBank.com) . A replay of the live webcast is expected to be available by the evening of October 22, 2026 through the Investor Relations section of[www.SouthStateBank.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787722-1&h=1034033618&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southstatebank.com%2F&a=www.SouthStateBank.com) .
